description: This project is a collaborative family effort by Citizen Scientists Deepak Sharma, his wife Pooja Sharma (cinematografy & support) , and there 7 - year 11 months old daughter Aaradhya Sharma (Junior Space Commander). Together we created the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer to  demonstrate acoustic fire suppression in space.

Working Prototype, Live Role-Play & Multimedia Package: - Live Role-Play Simulation Video: Recorded by Pooja Sharma (Mother/Videographer), featuring 7-year-old Aaradhya Sharma (Daughter) as the Mission Commander and Deepak Sharma (Father/Inventor) as a Crew Member (Astronaut). Together, this family team demonstrates a working prototype of how astronauts respond to acoustic and seismic emergencies on Mars. - Playable Space Emergency Game: A working C-language interactive prototype ("Pratham Base - Level 1: Mars Base") generated with Meta AI assistance based on our hand-drawn design chart, featuring a 30Hz–60Hz Frequency Controller Slider to extinguish fires in the life-support room. - 21-Slide Animated Story Video: Illustrated mission scenes with background music and dialogue subtitles. - Hand-Drawn Game Design Document (GDD) & Scripts: Original conceptual blueprints from Yamuna Nagar, Haryana (India), showing the "Acoustic & Seismic Shield" technology, NASA ISS & InSight Lander data integration, interface layouts, and mission planning PDFs.
